description: Create the components/dashboard/ directory with 7 new shared widget components (HeroBanner, StatRow, QuickActions, UpcomingSessionsWidget, CoachAvatarRow, BadgeMiniWidget, SupportCallout), and add the logoOnly prop to AppTopNav + DashboardLayout to hide the wordmark for client/coach portals. These are the building blocks consumed by FEAT-002.
steps:
2. Create c:\website\GrooveSystem\components\dashboard\HeroBanner.tsx — 'use client'. Props: { eyebrow: string; headline: string; subline: string; primaryCta: { label: string; href: string }; secondaryCta: { label: string; href: string }; announcement: Announcement | null }. Renders: outer
. Inside:

Renders: <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-5 xl:grid-cols-4'>. When loading: 4 x <div className='g-skeleton h-32 rounded-[20px]' aria-hidden />. . Each action: : {a.icon}{a.label}. Import Link from next/link.

Props: { appointments: Appointment[]; loading?: boolean; viewAllHref: string; perspective: 'client' | 'coach' }. Renders: <Card padding='md' className='h-full'>. CardHeader: icon=<Calendar className='h-4 w-4' />, title='Upcoming Sessions', subtitle='Your booked rehearsals', action=<Link href={viewAllHref} className='text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground hover:text-accent-text transition'>View all</Link>. Empty: <EmptyState compact icon=<Calendar className='h-5 w-5' /> title='No upcoming sessions.' description='Book a coach to schedule rehearsal.' actionHref={perspective==='client' ? '/client/talent' : '/coach/appointments'} action='Browse' />. Per appointment row (space-y-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-3.5 hover:border-border-strong transition): top row flex items-center justify-between gap-2 — name (perspective==='client': appt.coach?.firstname+' '+appt.coach?.lastname ?? 'Coach Session'; perspective==='coach': (appt as any).client?.firstname+' '+(appt as any).client?.lastname ?? appt.name ?? 'Student') truncate text-xs font-bold — plus <Badge variant={status==='confirmed' ? 'approved' : status==='pending' ? 'pending' : status==='cancelled' ? 'cancelled' : 'neutral'} dot>{appt.status}</Badge>. Bottom row: flex gap-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground — <Calendar h-3 w-3> formatDate(appt.date) and <Clock h-3 w-3> appt.start_time. showing coaches.slice(0,4). Imports: FullCoach from @/lib/types; Sparkles, ChevronRight from lucide-react; getInitials from @/lib/utils; Card, CardHeader, CardContent from @/components/ui/Card; EmptyState from @/components/shared/EmptyState; Link from next/link.

7. Create c:\website\GrooveSystem\components\dashboard\BadgeMiniWidget.tsx — 'use client'. Props: { userId: string; role: 'client' | 'coach' }. Uses hooks: useAchievements(userId, role) and useBadgeStatus(userId) — both from '@/lib/achievements/hooks'. useAchievements returns { achievements: AchievementWithProgress[], loading: boolean }; useBadgeStatus returns { badgeStatus: UserBadgeStatus | null, loading: boolean }. When loading (either hook): return <div className='g-skeleton h-28 rounded-[20px]' aria-hidden />. When loaded: render <Card padding='md'> with <CardHeader icon=<Award className='h-4 w-4' /> title='Badge Progress' subtitle='Complete tasks to earn your badge' /> then <BadgeCollection tasks={achievements} badgeStatus={badgeStatus} userId={userId} role={role} loading={achievementsLoading || badgeLoading} />. In the brand zone JSX (the g-header-logo Link), wrap the g-header-wordmark span: {!logoOnly && (...)}. Do not change any other logic.
